name: Sleep Through the Day
description: Sleep in a bed by day and the day passes 60x faster until the evening; then the clock runs normally again. Everyone has to be in bed by default (or each sleeper speeds it up, or a share of the players). Host or dedicated server; players who join need nothing. Installed switched off.

settings.label: Skip to (hour)
settings.help: The day races until this hour. Night falls at 18:00: stay in bed past it and the game's own night skip carries on.

options.label: Each sleeper speeds it up (2 of 4 in bed: 30x)
A share of the players (below), also at night

settings.label: Share in bed (%)
settings.help: This share of the players in bed gives the full speed, by day and (topping up the game's own skip) by night.

settings.label: How much faster
settings.help: 60 = as fast as the game's own night skip.

settings.label: Notes on screen
settings.help: When the day starts racing and when the evening comes (the host's screen; a server logs them).
